title: Things to do in Hyderabad — candidate audit

statuses.keep: Strong enough to launch once normal visit details are checked.
statuses.conditional: Distinctive, but seasonal, booking-dependent, religious, or access-sensitive.
statuses.drop: Too vague, weak, inaccessible, or based on an unsupported claim.

policy.coordinateRule: A pin must represent a real visitor entrance or named landmark, never a neighbourhood centroid, lake centre, or informal trail.
policy.researchRule: Do not publish volatile timings, prices, access promises, or superlatives without a dated primary source.

candidates.name: Charminar and Upper Gallery
candidates.hook: Climb inside Hyderabad's defining monument and read the old city from its four arches.
candidates.editorialNote: Keep the gallery experience; avoid claiming unrestricted access or fixed opening hours.

candidates.name: Chowmahalla Palace
candidates.hook: A Nizam-era palace complex with the Khilwat Mubarak durbar hall and royal collections.
candidates.editorialNote: Remove the unsupported claim that the entrance clock has run continuously for 250 years.

candidates.name: Purani Haveli and Nizam's Wardrobe
candidates.hook: A two-level wooden wardrobe and hand-operated lift inside the Nizam's former residence.
candidates.editorialNote: Pin the Nizam's Museum entrance, not the wider Purani Haveli compound.

candidates.name: Badshahi Ashurkhana
candidates.hook: A living Shia place of mourning with rare surviving Qutb Shahi glazed tilework.
candidates.editorialNote: Treat it as an active religious site and give modest-dress and prayer-time guidance.

candidates.name: Barkas Yemeni Food Quarter
candidates.hook: Hyderabad's Chaush and Hadhrami food culture in the neighbourhood where it took root.
candidates.editorialNote: Do not launch with a neighbourhood-centroid pin. Field-check and choose one stable restaurant or a short signed food-walk start point.

candidates.name: Dhoolpet Kite and Idol Workshops
candidates.hook: Seasonal lanes of handmade kites and festival-idol workshops.
candidates.editorialNote: Seasonal experience, not an all-year attraction. Field-check a respectful public route and never direct visitors into private workshops.

candidates.name: Mahboob Chowk Clock Tower
candidates.hook: A restored 1892 Turkish-style clock tower embedded in the working bazaar west of Charminar.
candidates.editorialNote: Drop the Sunday bird-auction recommendation; keep the architecture and bazaar context.

candidates.name: Paigah Tombs
candidates.hook: Extraordinary lime-stucco and pierced screens that look like stone lace.
candidates.editorialNote: Use the monument entrance pin and verify current restoration/access before launch.

candidates.name: Begum Bazaar Wholesale Walk
candidates.hook: A dense wholesale market walk through spices, dry fruit and old trading lanes.
candidates.editorialNote: Remove the fish-medicine framing and publish only after field-checking a precise walk start, finish, and safe visiting window.

candidates.name: Sitarambagh Temple
candidates.hook: A fortified temple complex mixing Rajasthani, Mughal and European details.
candidates.editorialNote: Do not promise stepwell access; it depends on permission and religious activity.

candidates.name: Abids Sunday Book Bazaar
candidates.hook: A Sunday-only pavement market for second-hand books, old magazines and surprise finds.
candidates.editorialNote: Pin a verified start point on Abids Road and make Sunday availability prominent.

candidates.name: British Residency, Koti
candidates.hook: A monumental Palladian residency tied to the White Mughals story, now inside a university campus.
candidates.editorialNote: Prior booking or campus permission may be required; never present it as walk-in access.

candidates.name: Moazzam Jahi Market and Famous Ice Cream
candidates.hook: A restored granite market and clock tower paired with an old-school seasonal-fruit ice cream stop.
candidates.editorialNote: Verify the exact Famous Ice Cream storefront pin during the photo/content pass.

candidates.name: Subhan Bakery
candidates.hook: A popular bakery for Osmania biscuits and seasonal Dum ke Roat.
candidates.editorialNote: The draft's 1880s founding and birthplace-of-Osmania-biscuit claims are not supportable. Better suited to the food map.

candidates.name: Hameedi Confectioners
candidates.hook: A heritage sweet shop whose distinctive order is Jouzi Halwa.
candidates.editorialNote: The supplied pin near Moazzam Jahi Market was about 1.2 km off; this pin is the Gun Foundry/Abids shop.

candidates.name: Secunderabad Clock Tower
candidates.hook: The civic landmark at the heart of old Secunderabad, best combined with a cantonment walk.
candidates.editorialNote: Do not oversell it as a standalone half-day attraction.

candidates.name: James Street and General Bazaar
candidates.hook: A historic commercial corridor.
candidates.editorialNote: Too diffuse and shop-dependent for a trustworthy pin; fold its best verified stops into a future Secunderabad walk.

candidates.name: All Saints' Church, Trimulgherry
candidates.hook: A living 1860 garrison church with stained glass, memorials and cantonment history.
candidates.editorialNote: Pin the church, not the whole entrenchment. Visit only around published services or with permission.

candidates.name: Spanish Mosque
candidates.hook: A rare Moorish-inspired mosque whose pointed spires look unlike almost anything else in Hyderabad.
candidates.editorialNote: Active place of worship: modest dress, no intrusion during prayer, and verify visitor access.

candidates.name: Marredpally Anglo-Indian Bakery Hub
candidates.hook: A proposed bakery crawl.
candidates.editorialNote: The draft names no dependable route and appears to contain an incorrect bakery name. Re-research from scratch before reconsidering.

candidates.name: Khajaguda Hills
candidates.hook: Ancient granite, caves and a dramatic city-edge landscape.
candidates.editorialNote: High X-factor, but current public access is disputed/restricted and the supplied pin is unreliable. Restore only after an on-ground access check.

candidates.name: Hathiyan ka Jhad Baobab
candidates.hook: A centuries-old African baobab inside the Naya Qila precinct.
candidates.editorialNote: The tree is fenced and reported locked; the draft's advice to enter through golf-course security is not safe visitor guidance.

candidates.name: Qutb Shahi Heritage Park
candidates.hook: A dynastic necropolis transformed by major conservation, with tombs, gardens and restored water structures.
candidates.editorialNote: Use the current Heritage Park identity; avoid unsupported claims about a 12-second echo or guaranteed hamam access.

candidates.name: Lamakaan
candidates.hook: An independent cultural space for theatre, film, talks and open-mics built around Banjara Hills rock.
candidates.editorialNote: The event is the experience. Pull or manually verify the current programme rather than promising a generic visit.

candidates.name: Lotus Pond
candidates.hook: A sunken urban nature loop that feels unexpectedly removed from Jubilee Hills traffic.
candidates.editorialNote: The supplied pin was roughly 900 m north of the pond. Avoid fixed bird lists and bloom promises.

candidates.name: Durgam Cheruvu Lakefront and Rock Walk
candidates.hook: A public lakefront walk where old granite meets the cable bridge and Cyberabad skyline.
candidates.editorialNote: Replace the vague 'secret southern trail' with a verified public promenade entrance.

candidates.name: Osman Sagar / Gandipet Lakefront
candidates.hook: A historic flood-control reservoir and broad western-sky sunset stop.
candidates.editorialNote: The supplied coordinate was in the reservoir/bund area, not a reliable visitor entrance. Pin a currently open park or viewpoint after field-checking; do not promise pumphouse access.

candidates.name: Tellapur Inscription and Stepwell Site
candidates.hook: A 1417 inscription recording a public stepwell and an early written use of the name Telangana.
candidates.editorialNote: Historically excellent but currently unprotected, unsigned and not visitor-ready. The draft incorrectly calls it a restored stepwell.

candidates.name: Shilparamam
candidates.hook: A large crafts campus where the best visit pairs makers' stalls with a live performance or fair.
candidates.editorialNote: Recommend it around a verified festival, exhibition or amphitheatre programme; otherwise it can feel generic.

candidates.name: Financial District Rock Ridgeline
candidates.hook: A proposed skyline viewpoint.
candidates.editorialNote: No named public viewpoint, entrance, or documented access. Do not direct users onto an informal ridge between private campuses.

candidates.name: Moula Ali Hill and Dargah
candidates.hook: A long stair climb up a granite hill to a living shrine and enormous city view.
candidates.editorialNote: The supplied pin was about 1 km east. Provide heat, footwear and religious-etiquette guidance.

candidates.name: Keesaragutta Temple and Hill Ruins
candidates.hook: A major Shiva hill shrine surrounded by scattered lingams and early historic remains.
candidates.editorialNote: The supplied pin was over 1.8 km southwest. Keep visitors on established temple paths; do not expose vulnerable archaeological coordinates.

candidates.name: Victoria Memorial Home
candidates.hook: A historic palace now used as a school.
candidates.editorialNote: Not a normal visitor attraction; a gate-only facade view is too weak for this map.

candidates.name: Rashtrapati Nilayam
candidates.hook: The President of India's southern retreat, opened through a formal booked visitor circuit.
candidates.editorialNote: The supplied pin was about 1 km north. Link directly to official ticketing and reflect closures or presidential use.

candidates.name: Holy Trinity Church, Bolarum
candidates.hook: An 1847 cantonment church with a remarkable Bolarum setting and living congregation.
candidates.editorialNote: The supplied pin was about 500 m north. Verify visitor hours and avoid treating worship as a tourist performance.

candidates.name: Kapra Lake
candidates.hook: A neighbourhood lake.
candidates.editorialNote: No solid support was found for the draft's megalithic-cluster claim at the lake, and encroachment makes it a weak leisure recommendation.

candidates.name: Shamirpet Lake
candidates.hook: An outlying reservoir framed by granite.
candidates.editorialNote: The lake-centre pin, deer-park adjacency and promontory access are not enough for a dependable destination. Reconsider only after a field visit.

candidates.name: Moosapet Brass Artisans Bazaar
candidates.hook: A proposed metalworking district.
candidates.editorialNote: No dependable source or named workshop supports this as a visitor experience; likely conflates Moosapet with other metal markets.

candidates.name: Dargah Hazrat Syed Shah Barhana Shah
candidates.hook: A proposed Sufi shrine visit.
candidates.editorialNote: The locality, pin, Thursday qawwali claim and visitor details could not be reliably verified. Do not publish yet.

candidates.name: Uppal Bhagayath Musi Riverbank
candidates.hook: A proposed riverfront walk.
candidates.editorialNote: Uppal Bhagayath is primarily a planned layout. The draft's ecological park, royal orchard and visitor-track story is not sufficiently supported.

candidates.name: Fly Zone Trampoline Park
candidates.hook: A large trampoline and obstacle arena with free-jump courts, battle beams and a ninja course.
candidates.editorialNote: Sky Zone at the same Gandipet address is the former/alternate identity, not a second venue. Publish only Fly Zone.

candidates.name: Jus' Jumpin'
candidates.hook: A weatherproof indoor activity park combining trampolines, climbing, obstacle courses and a 360-degree cycle.
candidates.editorialNote: Useful central alternative to Fly Zone, especially in summer or rain; keep the distinction clear rather than listing every trampoline venue.

candidates.name: Meco Kartainment
candidates.hook: A proper airport-side karting facility with recreational and championship-length circuits and lap timing.
candidates.editorialNote: The strongest dedicated karting pick. Prices and late-night hours are volatile, so retrieve them from the official rate card at publish time.

candidates.name: District Gravity Adventure Park
candidates.hook: A full-day adventure campus with a 1.2 km motorsport circuit, three-level ropes, giant swing, slingshot and long zip line.
candidates.editorialNote: Combine Chicane Circuit, the human slingshot and giant swing under this single venue instead of creating duplicate pins.

candidates.name: Play On by Hasten Go-Karting
candidates.hook: A 613 m technical kart circuit that gives east Hyderabad a serious alternative to the airport track.
candidates.editorialNote: Keep as the east-side karting option, not as another citywide must-do; verify kart maintenance and weather before recommending.

candidates.name: GravityZip Indoor Skydiving
candidates.hook: A vertical wind tunnel that delivers the sensation of freefall without an aircraft or parachute.
candidates.editorialNote: One of the list's clearest X-factor experiences. Require advance booking and pull current health, age and weight restrictions from the venue.

candidates.name: Wingmasters Tandem Paramotoring
candidates.hook: A pre-booked tandem paratrike flight over the reservoir landscape north-east of Hyderabad.
candidates.editorialNote: The pasted guide's Shamirpet location is stale. The active listing resolves to Mamidiyal and the operator names Kondapochamma Reservoir; confirm the launch field after booking because wind can change operations.

candidates.name: Hyderabad Paddle Park
candidates.hook: Indoor padel and pickleball courts with equipment rental, coaching and no membership requirement.
candidates.editorialNote: Use this as the single representative venue for the padel/pickleball trend rather than mapping every interchangeable court.

candidates.name: Crag Studio, Gachibowli
candidates.hook: A dedicated climbing gym with beginner workshops, bouldering, roped climbing and equipment rental.
candidates.editorialNote: Pin the current Gachibowli studio, not the older Kondapur description. The Mettuguda branch can be added later only if geographic coverage needs it.

candidates.name: Kotepally Reservoir Kayaking
candidates.hook: Seasonal kayaking on a reservoir near the Ananthagiri landscape, roughly 100 km from Hyderabad.
candidates.editorialNote: Water sports are seasonal and operator availability is inconsistent. Never promise kayaking without same-day confirmation; also surface the limited signage and amenities.

candidates.name: Wild Waters
candidates.hook: A large all-day water and amusement park with wave pools, major slides and dry rides.
candidates.editorialNote: Keep as the single large water-park recommendation; avoid turning the map into a catalogue of similar amusement parks.

candidates.name: Snow Kingdom Hyderabad
candidates.hook: A sub-zero indoor snow session with snowfall, slides and thermal clothing provided.
candidates.editorialNote: Use the Sarath City venue, not Snow World at Lower Tank Bund, to avoid duplicate near-identical experiences.

candidates.name: Escape Time, Madhapur
candidates.hook: A team puzzle experience built around physical rooms, hidden mechanisms and a one-hour deadline.
candidates.editorialNote: Use one well-established escape-room operator rather than listing every branch and brand; room themes should be treated as changeable.
